description: This file defines the IBasketService interface, which declares methods for basket operations such as transferring, adding items, setting quantities, and deleting a basket in the eCommerce application.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: An interface providing basket management operations such as transfer, add item, set quantities, and delete.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers a basket from an anonymous user to a named user account.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket with specified catalog item ID, price, and optional quantity.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets the quantities for items in a basket, identified by basket ID, using a dictionary of item identifiers and quantities.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes the basket identified by the given basket ID.
